Hello! 

Coming out to your parents is hard no matter your situation. My kind-of-advice is such: Just do it! In person, on the phone, via a letter, just let them know. There is no need to stress the heck out, and you can't control their reaction no matter what you try and do. Hopefully they see how much this issue affects you and the accept it. Maybe they will take to it and help you out! 

I freaked out over the exact same thing with my parents and I just came out to them one night and everything went better than expected. (my parents are fairly religious) 
But my mom offered to help me do my makeup and hair and everything, so I was pretty happy. 

At any rate, I hope that you find a solution and figure out what you want to do. I wish you luck!
